latest.name: Voicewoven 1.0.0
latest.notes:
# Voicewoven 1.0.0

This is the first stable version of Voicewoven. It is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. It is signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so macOS opens it with the usual first-open question instead of blocking it.

Voicewoven records microphone and system audio, transcribes meetings locally, separates voices, and organizes meetings with Tags and Tasks.

## What is new

- **Summary templates.** In a meeting's **Summary** tab, choose how the next summary is written: General meeting, Daily standup, Technical discussion, One-on-one, Client meeting, Interview, or Lecture or class. Each template asks for its own sections, and Voicewoven writes the section names in the language of the meeting. **Settings > Recording** sets the template new meetings use. Templates of your own are not available in this version.
- **Earlier summaries are kept.** A new summary no longer replaces the previous one. The Summary tab lists the versions newest first, and you can show or delete each one.
- **Models come from fixed, checked versions.** Voicewoven downloads the speech and summary models from fixed versions and checks the size and SHA-256 of every file before anything loads it. A file that is not the expected version is never installed or loaded, and **Check** then says the model needs a repair. Downloads through a company proxy that asks for a sign-in now work with the sign-in macOS saved.
- **A transcription that stops progressing ends by itself.** When the transcription helper stops responding, Voicewoven stops it, keeps the audio, and lets you try again. You can also cancel a transcription that is running.
- **Easier to read and to use with the keyboard.** Text and buttons have stronger contrast, the window adapts down to 768 px wide so zoom no longer scrolls sideways, and the focus goes back to a sensible place after Stop, after Settings and after dialogs.
- **Clearer messages.** A meeting waiting behind another one's job says so, the welcome screen shows the download progress and why a download failed, and an error is said once, where you are looking.
- **Safer backups.** Every backup folder has a `README.txt` that lists what it contains and how to restore it. The README now warns before replacing files on a Mac that already has meetings.
- **The transcript follows the audio.** While a meeting plays, the transcript scrolls to the turn being heard. Scroll it yourself and it stays where you put it, until the next **Play** or a click on a turn.
- **Permissions one click away.** A click on **Microphone** or **System audio** at the bottom of the sidebar checks the permissions again and opens the permissions window with the steps that are missing.
- **Smaller fixes.** Audio is kept when the language of a transcript could not be confirmed. Record works even when a settings file cannot be read, and choosing **Use** on a prepared speech model repairs an unreadable transcription settings file and transcribes the meetings that waited. Meeting text that Voicewoven gives to MCP clients is marked as untrusted, so the client does not follow instructions spoken in a meeting. Tasks lists the accepted tasks before the suggestions. On a narrow window the transcript scrolls in its own box, so the Summary, Tasks and Details stay in reach.

## Please read

- **Update from a preview.** If you have 0.1.29-preview.1 or later, this version arrives through **Update and restart**. Check that your microphone and system audio permissions still work afterwards. From 1.0.0 on, Voicewoven only offers stable versions.
- **Use headphones in calls.** Voicewoven has no echo cancellation yet. When the other people come out of the Mac's speakers, the microphone records them again: their voices sound doubled in playback, and each of their sentences can appear twice in the transcript, under two voices. Headphones usually avoid it. The same doubling was also reported on a call that probably used wireless headphones, and that case is being investigated. Removing the echo is planned for a later version.
- **Check every summary before you share it.** The local AI model can get details wrong with any template: in tests it sometimes changed a number, invented a date, or gave a commitment to the wrong person. The built-in templates were checked with the local model on scripted English, Spanish and Portuguese meetings and one Japanese meeting. The section names in German, French, Dutch and Italian come from the app's translations and were not checked with the model.
- **Not yet observed on a Mac:** the checks listed in `docs/request-queue.md`, including VoiceOver, the in-place update from 0.1.30, the backup copied to iCloud Drive and an external disk, and the installed app on a second Mac. macOS 14 has not been exercised.
- German, French, Japanese, Dutch, and Italian interface texts were translated by an AI model (Claude) and reviewed by another (Codex). No native speaker has reviewed them yet. Please report wording problems.
- Speech and AI models download separately and need additional disk space. Generated transcripts, speaker labels, summaries, and answers need review.

## Validation

The automated tests, the native helper tests, the Rust tests and the production build pass on the exact source of this version, and GitHub's hosted checks passed for each change since the previous preview. Independent reviews of each change, a headless click-through of every main flow in eight languages and a usability session found defects that were fixed before release. The summary templates were checked against the real local model on scripted meetings.
